Kya tumhein dhaanp lene waali qiyaamat ki baat maaloom hai
Us din bahut se chehre zaleel aur ruswa honge
Mehnat karne waale thake hue
Dahakti hui aag mein daakhil honge
Inhein kholte hue paani ke chashme se seeraab kiya jaaega
Un ke liye koi khaana siwaaye khaardaar jhaadi ke na hoga
Jo na motaapa paida kar sake aur na bhook ke kaam aa sake
Aur kuch chehre tar o taaza honge
Apni mehnat o riyaazat se khush
Buland-tareen Jannat mein
Jahaan koi laghw aawaaz na sunaai de
Wahaan chashme jaari honge
Wahaan oonche oonche takht honge
Aur atraaf mein rakhe hue pyaale honge
Aur qataar se lage hue gaao-takiye honge
Aur bichhi hui behtareen masnadein hongi
Kya yeh log oont ki taraf nahin dekhte hain ke use kis tarah paida kiya gaya hai
Aur aasmaan ko kis tarah buland kiya gaya hai
Aur pahaad ko kis tarah nasb kiya gaya hai
Aur zameen ko kis tarah bichhaaya gaya hai
Lihaaza tum naseehat karte raho ke tum sirf naseehat karne waale ho
Tum un par musallat aur un ke zimmedaar nahin ho
Magar jo munh pher le aur kaafir ho jaaye
To Khuda use bahut bade azaab mein mubtala karega
Phir hamaari hi taraf un sab ki baazgasht hai
Aur hamaare hi zimme un sab ka hisaab hai
